# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa provides a fixed-fee Dental Acquisition Record Review: a read-only readiness sample, source-linked portfolio Care Ledger, and accountable post-close handoff.
> The broader mixed-PMS operating layer, Owner Morning Brief, and governed agents are product direction after close—not the current commercial deliverable.

Leyoxa LLC is a Texas company with a registered office in Austin. Founder Sepehr Aflatounian is based in Toronto. The immediate commercial focus is US dental acquisitions, followed by Canada.

## Available now

- [Acquisition Review](https://leyoxa.com/whats-live.html): readiness sample, approved read-only snapshot, cross-source reconciliation, portfolio Care Ledger, owner-assigned worklist, methodology, limitations, and audit trail.
- Buyer: dental-group corporate development, diligence, and integration leaders with a dated acquisition or portfolio handoff.
- Commercial model: fixed portfolio engagement priced by location count, PMS mix, historical depth, access path, close date, and delivery window.

## Product direction after close

- [Platform](https://leyoxa.com/workspace.html): connect approved sources across mixed PMS and business systems, prompt the owner brief or another role-specific workspace, review permissions, and activate bounded agents.
- [Intelligence](https://leyoxa.com/intelligence.html): rank locations and anomalies by estimated opportunity, urgency, confidence, and effort; carry each recommendation through action and outcome verification.
- Connected sources remain authoritative and retain provenance.
- Generated workspaces inherit purpose, role, location, field, and human-approval boundaries.
- Agents may verify sources, assign work, prepare reports, or escalate exceptions within an approved action set.

## Post-close flagship direction

- The Owner Morning Brief covers production, chair utilization, unanswered calls, recall, unscheduled treatment, collections, reviews, and marketing.
- Each opportunity includes source evidence, calculation method, estimated value, realistic recovery range, confidence evidence, accountable owner, recommended action, and attribution window.
- Financial stages remain separate: identified opportunity, actioned value, and verified recovered outcome.
- Opportunity is estimated and is never represented as guaranteed revenue.
- Agent actions progress from read and preparation to approval-gated communication or system action; clinical authority remains with qualified people.

## First buyer and trigger

- Buyer: dental-group corporate development, diligence, and integration leaders.
- Trigger: a dated acquisition or portfolio handoff.
- Commercial model: fixed portfolio engagement, not per-seat practice SaaS.
- Pricing factors: location count, PMS mix, historical depth, access path, close date, and delivery window.
- Public planning range: USD $7,500–$15,000 for a readiness sample; $15,000–$30,000 for one full location. Final fixed scope follows access and quality review.
- Differentiation: not generic treatment mining or a DSO analytics dashboard; the transaction-specific evidence package covers source-linked exceptions, record continuity, documentation gaps, migration verification, explicit limitations, and buyer sign-off.

## Acquisition Review engagement

- [Acquisition review](https://leyoxa.com/whats-live.html): readiness sample, approved read-only snapshot, portfolio reconciliation, and accountable handoff.
- [Care Ledger](https://leyoxa.com/care-ledger.html): source-linked record states organized by location, PMS, owner, age, and next action.
- [Post-close handoff](https://leyoxa.com/workspace.html): preserve the acquisition snapshot, reconcile approved fields, assign owners, and export the audit trail.
- [Periodontal example](https://leyoxa.com/perio.html): one record category showing source-linked longitudinal reconciliation without generated diagnosis.
- [Trust Center](https://leyoxa.com/security.html)
- [Contact](https://leyoxa.com/page-contact.html)

## Readiness gates

- Prove a permitted read path for every PMS in the cohort.
- Sample chart-note quality and source completeness before accepting full scope.
- State unavailable fields and unsupported history explicitly.
- Agree the reporting, responsibility, retention, and handoff protocol before production access.

Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Curve, and other PMS names describe possible acquisition environments. They are not claims of currently available connectors. Direct database, approved export, vendor, or third-party access may be required.

## Output states

- Evidence documented; diagnosis not recorded; dentist should re-evaluate.
- Diagnosed or recommended care recorded; no later completion or re-presentation record found.
- Treatment sequence started; no completion record found.
- Source incomplete; hold for verification.
- Every output links back to its source record and date.

## Clinical and system boundary

- Leyoxa reports record states, not untreated disease or clinical findings.
- Leyoxa does not assert diagnoses, recommend treatment, or generate clinical notes.
- The product is read-only and does not write charts, plans, diagnoses, appointments, or communications to a PMS.
- Each acquired practice and its dentist retain clinical responsibility.
- Plan value is ledger context, not revenue; any acceptance scenario is illustrative and not guaranteed.

## Post-close ownership

- Dentist review is limited to the highest-priority clinical slice.
- Appropriate reviewed items may be attached to an existing scheduled visit.
- Coordinators may own re-presentation of already diagnosed and documented care.
- Incomplete or ambiguous records remain held for source verification.
- The acquirer receives the ledger, methodology, limitations, owner-assigned worklist, and exportable audit trail.

## Current commercial boundary

The platform direction is broader than the current commercial offer. Acquisition readiness, retrospective record reconciliation, and post-close handoff are the first bounded use case. Public interfaces do not claim that every connector, generated dashboard, or agent action is live today.

## Proof status

Public product interfaces use fictional data and describe product direction, not customer results. Chart-note quality, PMS read access, and the legal consequences of reporting record states are explicit pre-engagement risks.

## Shipped work

- [Praxis AI](https://leyoxa.com/case-praxis.html): flagship venture-studio collaboration with an independent dental AI company; its live agents and public product claims remain Praxis's own.
- [SmileLink](https://leyoxa.com/case-smilelink.html): shipped patient access, scheduling, secure communication, and clinic workflow software.
- [Emergclinic](https://leyoxa.com/case-emergclinic.html): completed Toronto emergency-dental routing pilot; no longer live.
- [Selected work](https://leyoxa.com/case-studies.html): ownership, contribution, and current status are stated per case.

## Insights

- [Beyond the dental chart audit](https://leyoxa.com/blog/dental-acquisition-record-review-care-ledger.html): distinguish diligence, PMS migration validation, and a source-linked post-close Care Ledger.
- [Records after acquisitions](https://leyoxa.com/blog/dental-software-stack-after-acquisitions.html): preserve longitudinal provenance as a dental group grows.
- [Owner Morning Brief](https://leyoxa.com/blog/owner-morning-brief-dental-groups.html): one ranked daily operating view across mixed dental systems.
- [Opportunity to verified recovery](https://leyoxa.com/blog/dental-opportunity-to-verified-recovery.html): separate estimated, actioned, booked, produced, and collected value.
- [Governed AI agents](https://leyoxa.com/blog/governed-ai-agents-dental-operations.html): observe, recommend, approve, act, escalate, and verify.
